The Mandelbrot set drawn in characters, its rows made by one map (C42).
Prior art: the Mandelbrot set (Benoit Mandelbrot, 1980); drawing it in characters is as old as line printers.
ek6e3evg22rdkiap87m3hm9c68: The Mandelbrot set as a page: each press of Draw draws it again with 1000 more steps a point, so its edge grows finer. The picture is one map over the rows inside the button's handler. Each line only computes, so in a browser the compiled page sends the rows out to workers started from its own script, and the handler waits for them. While it waits the page shows nothing new and takes no other event, so the picture and everything around it are the same as drawing the rows in turn.
